A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Conformal Linguistic Calibration study. Text and rendered-page inspection support comparison of all scientific content, including figures, tables, equations and Appendices A–F. The checklist removal in v4 is identifiable, not a reading gap.

before.justification: v2 reports original QA calibration, informativeness and FActScore experiments in Section 4, plus manual belief-summary validation in Section 3.1 and rewriting examples in Appendix D.

after.justification: v4 retains these original empirical outcomes in Sections 3.1 and 4, Figures 3–4 and Appendix D.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.2 retain identical answer sampling, semantic clustering, nested-set construction, belief rewriting and LTT calibration. The claim-rewriter training approaches in Section 4.3 are also unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use SimpleQA, the same short-answer subset of Natural Questions, and biography claims from the CORE expansion of FActScore. No training or evaluation coverage is added or removed.

E2.justification: The abstention comparator in Section 4.1, naive rewriting baseline in Section 4.2, and Base/SFT/DPO/ORPO comparison in Section 4.3 retain identical membership.

E3.justification: Section 4 preserves the split procedures, 100 sampled responses per question, multiplicity thresholds, model configurations, CPMI preprocessing and CORE/FActScore evaluation protocol.

E4.justification: The manual assessment of belief-summary faithfulness, specificity–informativeness analysis, rewriter comparisons and Appendix D/Table 6 case studies are retained unchanged.

E5.justification: Figure 4 retains its 95% confidence-interval reporting. The deleted checklist's statistical-significance answer merely referred to Section 4; it supplied no additional run counts, seeds or uncertainty-estimation procedures.

E6.justification: Figures 3–4 and Table 6 are identical, as are the manual-validation precision of 0.81 and recall of 0.91. No numerical or qualitative result entries are added, removed or corrected.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, conformal/LTT formulation, Theorem 3.2 and its Appendix C proof are unchanged. Removing the checklist's pointer to Appendix C does not remove theoretical content.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about unifying linguistic calibration with set prediction, controlling the factuality–specificity tradeoff, providing risk guarantees and training adaptive claim rewriters.

C2.justification: The prompting and nesting limitations, LTT justification, experimental interpretations and Appendix E impact statement remain unchanged. The deleted checklist's limitations summary repeats qualifications retained in Section 3.

D1.justification: Deleting checklist items 5 and 13 removes statements that a reproduction codebase was submitted and that the rewriting dataset and model would be released on Hugging Face upon camera-ready. The general release claim, prompts, settings, hardware information and dataset/license disclosures remain. This establishes a documentation loss, not a change in actual artifact availability.

R1.justification: All 80 bibliographic works and the related-work discussion in Appendix A are unchanged. The added funding acknowledgment does not alter research positioning.

P1.justification: v4 adds Section 6, Acknowledgements, removes the standalone NeurIPS checklist and updates the version stamp. These are ancillary structural edits; the scientific narrative and Appendices A–F are otherwise unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–4 and Tables 1–6 retain identical displays and captions. The acknowledgment changes reference-page layout, while checklist removal shifts the unchanged appendices from pages 23–30 to pages 16–23.

improvement.justification: The scientific argument, empirical evidence, proofs and scientific appendices are unchanged. v4 adds funding transparency and removes mostly administrative checklist material, while losing brief code-submission and planned-release disclosures. Those statements supplied no concrete artifact link, and the existing technical details and general release claim remain. These limited tradeoffs amount to no meaningful net difference in overall paper quality.
